continuity: So Gyo identifies Jin Taekyung as the Martial God’s chosen one and says she has kept a long story about it to herself; she will explain when the situation allows.
Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung openly express gratitude for each other’s steadfast support.
Jeok Cheongang, Hyuk Mujin, Ju Hwaran, Song Ilseom, Sama Pyo, Taishan, and the Divine Physician all survived and reunited with Jin Taekyung.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord recalls that his mother and Master were killed; their suffering remains vivid to him, while their happy faces have faded from his memory.

The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord claims Dark Heaven has agents throughout the land and predicts civil war in the Great Nation followed by an advance into the Central Plains. This remains his claim, not a confirmed outcome.
plot: After the battle, So Gyo tells Jin Taekyung through Sound Transmission that he is the chosen one the Martial God spoke of, promising to explain later. Taekyung reunites with his surviving allies, thanks Jeok Cheongang, and walks to confront the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord.

The Demon Lord recalls his murdered mother and Master, then claims that Dark Heaven’s agents are spread throughout the land and that civil war will engulf the Great Nation before Dark Heaven advances into the Central Plains.
translation_decisions: Keep “Force” for 강기 distinct from “death energy” for 사기.
Render 엄마신장 as “Mom’s Divine Palm” in Jin Taekyung’s joking explanation.

active_continuity: So Gyo is the Bow Saint; her two curved swords can join into the bow’s original form.
So Gyo identifies Jin Taekyung as the Martial God’s chosen one and intends to explain the long story behind it later; her allegiance remains unknown.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord remains alive at the scene; he claims Dark Heaven’s agents are spread throughout the land and predicts civil war and an invasion of the Central Plains.
The rebel battle at the grand banquet hall has ended; the apparent ringleaders are being kept alive for questioning.
The Salcheonmun vowed to pursue Mungyeong regardless of cost or delay and may pursue Jin Taekyung if it learns he killed Gye Yabu.
Jeok Cheongang, Hyuk Mujin, Ju Hwaran, Song Ilseom, Sama Pyo, Taishan, and the Divine Physician survived and reunited with Jin Taekyung.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s mother and Master were killed; he remembers their suffering vividly but can barely recall their happy faces.
open_questions: What enabled Jin Taekyung to return from his seemingly fatal injuries?
What is the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s condition, and what information does he hold about Dark Heaven and the Lord of Heaven?
Where is Ma Sanbao, and what is his current status?
What does the Martial God’s reference to a chosen one mean for Jin Taekyung, and what story has So Gyo kept to herself?
Will the Salcheonmun pursue Mungyeong or discover that Jin Taekyung killed Gye Yabu?
temporary_decisions: Keep “Force” for 강기 distinct from “death energy” for 사기.

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** His hatred of rulers is rooted in the loss of his family to the violence of the age of chaos and the destruction of the Maoshan Sect, where he had found happiness.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** His hatred of rulers is rooted in the loss of his family and the destruction of the Maoshan Sect; the grief endures, while memories of their happiness have faded.
